decisions.reason: Drops redundant “in total” and uses “the last of them,” which captures 그중 마지막 more cleanly.
“Drew back” is a more physical match for 거둬들이는; “steel” is already established.
“About the same” carries the casual shrug of 뭐, 비슷하고 better than flat “similar.”
무슨 무공 is “what martial arts”; “which” slightly narrows the question.
“Let out a quiet laugh” fits involuntary 피식 웃었다 better than “gave.”
“Caught himself” matches the social recovery of 퍼뜩 정신을 차렸다 after agreeing too readily.
SOL drops 그런 것보다, losing the contrast with the previous reason.
Specifies 무공 as “martial arts,” which BASE generalizes away.
“Learned to use … weapons” is natural English for 무기를 익히다; BASE is calqued.
그건 무공도 아니었고 is a flat negation; SOL’s “could hardly be called” softens it.
한 우물만 파는 is specializing in one thing, not “mastering even one weapon.”
Warm-up and quiet speech are merged into the next line without losing content.
Merges the hand warm-up with murmured “try it like this,” matching 이렇게 한번 해 볼까.
SOL’s tighter follow-on is good, but 두 다리 is legs, not feet.
decisions.replacement: His legs crossed in a blur. A flash followed, slamming into the steel dummy’s chest.

decisions.reason: “Briefly forgotten” is the natural rendering of 잠시 잊고.
“Just to finish” preserves 먹기도; SOL’s “single” does not add enough to justify the swap.
“Adding and removing” matches 집어넣고 쳐내는; BASE’s “changes” is vaguer.
Keeps the 무공의 천재 fragment and renders 결코 as “in the slightest.”
“The thought sent a chill” preserves 생각이 들어 소름 돋았을, which BASE splits off.
“Snapped me back” is a sharper match for 그제야 정신이 들었다 after zoning out.
한눈을 팔아 is inattention, not looking away; SOL’s “big brother” breaks the chapter’s 형님/hyung rendering.
decisions.replacement: “Your hyung went to the trouble of giving you a demonstration, and you dare let your mind wander?”

decisions.reason: “Watched me suffer” is the natural English for 고통스러워하는 모습; SOL is noun-heavy.
“You made me forget!” is the spoken accusation 너 때문에 까먹었잖아 wants.
SOL smooths 말로 but drops 몸으로, which pays off “physical conversation.”
decisions.replacement: “You don’t understand when things are explained in words. It’ll be faster for you to experience them with your body.”

decisions.reason: The piss/shit exchange is more idiomatic and closer to 똥도 누고 오세요, 할 것 같아.
지금은 비무잖아 is “we’re sparring now”; SOL’s “only” is an added hedge.
Clipped “Informal speech again” matches Mukyung’s irritated 또 반말 쓰네.
“Tightened his grip and charged” is more dynamic for 말아 쥔 … 달려들었다.
“Threw myself aside” is more natural action prose for 몸을 날렸다 than “launched myself away.”
“Followed close behind” captures 따라붙었다; BASE’s “followed me” is weaker.
Keeps 지금부터 and the “teach you a lesson” threat; SOL’s “Allow me to begin” drops from-now and turns polite.
SOL tightens 파공성 well but replaces 입꼬리 with generic “lips.”
decisions.replacement: The sound of air tearing was anything but ordinary. I turned and swung my spear at the same time, but I was already too late. The faintly upturned corner of Jin Mukyung’s mouth was right in front of me.

decisions.reason: “Wavering vision” is the natural collocation for 흔들린 시야 after the punch.
고수 is a more skilled fighter, not merely “stronger”; later lines use 강하다 separately.
“To the wall” matches 벽면까지; “into the wall” overstates impact.
“Along with” is the cleaner rendering of 핏물과 함께.
“Scared little brat” matches 자식, 겁먹기는; “coward” over-translates getting spooked.
BASE’s “hitting things” is stiff; SOL adds an unsupported “you” to 손맛은 이게 더 좋거든.
decisions.replacement: “I can’t. It feels better with this.”

decisions.reason: “Vanished” and “might do” are slightly cleaner without changing 후환이 두렵지만.
잘 모르겠는데 is “don’t really know,” not “don’t know exactly.”
“The instant … rushed at me” matches 말이 끝나기가 무섭게 … 쇄도했다 more tightly.
Subjectless 칠해 놨나 is generic; SOL pins it on Mukyung and swaps “this” for “that.”
“Open up some distance,” “coiled,” and “thrust” are more idiomatic for 거리를 벌려야 / 칭칭 휘감으며 찔러 들어온다.
Clipped “What else?” matches 뭐긴 better than the expanded BASE line.
“Training in blood and sweat” is closer to 피땀 흘려 가며 수련; BASE adds “covered in.”
BASE adds “wave” and drops 깊은; SOL turns 둘째치고 into “nothing compared.”
decisions.replacement: Never mind the pain; a deep fury surged through me.

decisions.reason: “Christmas dates” is the natural collocation for 크리스마스에 … 데이트.
“In quick succession” is the natural English for 연이어 pounding blows.
창을 흩뿌렸다 is scattering strikes every which way; SOL’s “flurry” loses that image.
“Give ground” is more exact for 밀리기 than “retreat,” and “assault” fits 공세.
제대로 들어간 건 아니다 means it had not landed properly; SOL omits 제대로.
“Drove my fist” is the right verb for 일권을 내질렀다; “thrust” sounds like a spear.
페이크다 is present-tense in the moment of the punch; SOL’s past tense dulls it.
“At this distance” is cleaner than generic-you “when you were standing this close.”
“My confusion lasted only a moment” is smoother for 어리둥절한 것도 잠시.
“Pain-blurred” and “bashfully lift” are stronger collocations for the 수줍게 reveal through pain.
Punchier “No.” and “crammed” match 아니다 and 꽉꽉 채워 넣었으니까.
“A pocket near” is tighter than “one of the pockets” for 주머니에서.
“To hell with all that” carries 그딴 거 없다 in Taekyung’s voice.
회심의 기술 is a prized/decisive move, not a “deadly” one.
멀쩡한 is remaining fine/unscathed, not specifically remaining standing.
여기 한 명 추가요 is the add-one-to-the-list joke; SOL flattens it.
말하는 듯했다 is “seemed to say”; SOL makes it definite and adds “never seen anyone.”
“I’m getting tired of talking” is spoken Mukyung for 말하는 것도 지치는군.
“Limp to my feet” and “kicked my ankle out from under me” are clearer action for 절뚝거리며 … 발목을 걷어차이고.
Removes BASE’s blatantly/obviously redundancy while keeping 대놓고 의심받을.
고개를 들었다 is lifting his head; SOL’s “looked up at the hardness” is awkward and less exact.
“Gleefully” matches 신이 나서 better than “enthusiastically.”
Splitting off the Adam’s apple beat sets up Gulp more cleanly.
“Buckled … throwing me off balance” is stronger physical prose for 꺾인 팔이 중심을 잃는다.
“Ignored me and swung” is a tighter rendering of 아랑곳하지 않고 목검을 휘둘렀다.
Keeps the Korean’s two-beat pause after 사지가 잘린 거다 before naming the Peak master.
“He’d have other methods” is tighter spoken English for 다른 방법도 있지.
“Curled back,” “went rigid,” and plural “conditions” match 말려들어 갔다 / 굳고 and the two notices.
제압당했습니다 is subdued, and it must pair with later 제압이 풀립니다; SOL’s “struck” changes the System verb.
“So much as a hair or make a single sound” covers 털끝 하나 and 목소리조차 more fully than “could not speak.”
“Could only circle … unable to escape” is smoother for 머릿속에서만 맴돌 뿐.
“Every bone” and “go insane” are more natural for 전신의 뼈 and 미치광이가 되거나.
네가 누군지도 잊을 is “who you are”; SOL’s “were” shifts the identity to the past.
Fronts the cold touch and uses “dug into” for 살을 파고들었다 rather than “pressed.”
“I’m going to die? Like this?” makes the incredulous 죽는다고 thought unambiguous.
Keeps the 게이트에서, 무림에서 pause and “survive” for 살아남겠다고.
Need the fragment continuing “die … to him,” plus 놈 and 친형이라는; BASE loses 놈, SOL adds “Killed by.”
decisions.replacement: To that bastard who was supposed to be my biological older brother, even though we did not share a single drop of blood!

decisions.reason: “Could only stare … as” captures paralyzed 천장만 바라보는 and folds in the Reaper voice.
흘러내리는 is ongoing trickling; SOL’s simple “trickle” makes it a completed drop.
무림에서 잠들다 is the sleep euphemism that sets up closing his eyes; “laid to rest” is a different image.
Plural “acupoints were sealed” matches two 점혈 hits better than singular “hit at an acupoint.”
Participial “proving” is more immediate for 오감이 … 증명한다.
BASE’s “everything” erases the real cut; SOL loses 목덜미 and adds “terror”/“unbearable.”
decisions.replacement: I hurriedly felt the back of my neck. The cut stung, and blood came away on my fingers, but there were only a few drops of it. Everything else had been an illusion brought on by the fear and tension of death.
